summary: Frontend E2E testing of PostCallModal + offlineQueue on LeadDetail page. Logged in as agent@test.com, opened a lead, verified Log Call button opens PostCallModal, filled duration/outcome (Connected)/notes, saved, and confirmed entry appears in Call History with correct duration (2m 15s) and Connected badge on the lead. Then simulated offline via Playwright context.set_offline(True): offline banner rendered in both LeadDetail page and modal, saving a call log persisted item in localStorage (offline_call_queue key). Restored online and confirmed auto-sync fired ('Back online, syncing queue' -> 'Synced' -> queue length = 0). All requested features are working.

integration_issues.flow: LeadDetail refetch after offline call log
integration_issues.issue: When onCallLogged fires while offline, LeadDetail.fetchData hits Network Error and shows alert('Lead not found') then navigates back (line 93-95 of LeadDetail.js). The lead does exist; failure is only due to being offline. UX should skip refetch when !networkOnline or handle network error gracefully instead of navigating away.

action_items: Handle offline network errors in LeadDetail.fetchData: do not alert 'Lead not found' and navigate(-1) when navigator.onLine=false or when error has no response (network error). Instead, keep existing lead state and log/toast the sync status.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetail.js fetchData treats every fetch failure as 'Lead not found' -> forced back-navigation. Distinguish 404 from network errors (error.response?.status === 404).

offlineQueue.js starts auto-sync at module import (side effect on `if (typeof window !== 'undefined')`). This runs even on the login screen for unauthenticated users; consider starting it in an app-level provider after auth is established to avoid spurious 401s on the queue endpoints.
PostCallModal.js: `parseInt(e.target.value || 0)` should pass a radix and guard NaN (e.g., `parseInt(v, 10) || 0`) to avoid NaN duration when field is cleared.
PostCallModal.js: uses native `alert()` for offline confirmation and errors -- inconsistent with the rest of the app that uses toasts; consider swapping to the existing toast system.
offlineQueue.js: `substr` is deprecated; use `slice` or `crypto.randomUUID()` for queue item IDs.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing 'Test Customer' lead). Test call log 'TEST_ automated call log note' was saved to backend and 'TEST_ offline queued call' was queued offline then synced.

The only issue found is a UX bug where LeadDetail refetch after an offline log-call causes navigate(-1) due to Network Error being mis-treated as 404. Two TEST_ prefixed call logs were created against lead 6a8e98b345f946c3fd02baf0 (Test Customer) - clean up if needed via /api/call-logs.
rca of the issue: LeadDetail.js lines 82-98: `fetchData` catches ANY axios error and unconditionally alerts 'Lead not found' + navigates back. When user saves a call log while offline, PostCallModal calls onCallLogged -> fetchData -> axios throws Network Error (no response) -> caught -> user is bounced off the LeadDetail page. Fix: `if (error.response?.status === 404) { alert('Lead not found'); navigate(-1); } else { console.error(error); }`.
